Fully functioning MVP

The project allows for users to have basic Plural Quadratic Voting with Sybil resistance on Snapbrillia.

This project's final capabilities will provide demonstrable frameworks and technologies to enable Cardano DAO makers to offer Plural Quadratic Voting based solutions through added KYC-to-DID/VCs, and other advanced Sybil resistance functionality.
ms.criteria: The demonstration of capabilities has shown the MVP functionality
ms.report:
This is a completely FREE tool for any DAO on Cardano to use Plural Quadratic Voting to vote on proposals and make governance decisions for their DAO right in their Discord server.

We have made significant progress toward completing this project's goals. We are about 93.8% there and have completed 15 of 16 major tasks. Also, one last task is currently in progress and is nearly completed for 100% completion. There are also video demonstrations of Proof of Achievement for completing all milestones for this project, only missing the close-out video and project close-out report that's work in progress here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-ZGeJXiD--kCz9G1EsXv1WPZS37Vufv5C9_NPnu3yk/

As demonstrated in the demo video here:
https://youtu.be/G_2GhTMDmXk
https://youtu.be/g-cvS59wx5c?t=226

Plural Voting and Identity for DAOs, as deployed in the Snapbrillia Discord bot and installable for any DAO in their Discord server, can be found here:
https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1082698578293698680&permissions=380910160944&scope=bot

The open-source GitHub repo is here:
https://github.com/Snapbrillia/quadraticvoting/

Please see Proof of Achievements of Milestones and Monthly Progress Report details here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Iqr1DBgYqU9toNVilg5zVnOFEVTxWed6FVxAWULUdAk/
